_biz_reviews.author: Kelly Rolen
_biz_reviews.text: We were looking for a local bar with reasonable costs of food and drink and not a tourist trap. Needless to say we found it. The food and drinks are very reasonable and the staff is one of a kind and very attentive to guests. We called our crew and spent several hours socializing and shooting pool at the Undertow. We will certainly be back on this trip and will frequent the Undertow when we are in the area.

_biz_reviews.author: Stacy McNair
_biz_reviews.text: If you're looking for a great burger and in-house breaded chicken tenders, this is your place. Our food was delicious and service was excellent! It was great to see DJ after many years! We will definitely be back.

_biz_reviews.author: Kaitlin Walling
_biz_reviews.text: The place was awesome! The food and drinks were amazing. The cook truly cares, he even came out to ask us how everything was.

_biz_reviews.author: Sophia Grisoli
_biz_reviews.text: My Alabama-home-away-from-home. Was visiting from Louisiana and wanted to hit a dive bar where the locals were. This place is so much fun and everything i had in mind. The live music was 10/10 and above all else, the bartender DJ was better than Joe

_biz_reviews.author: William Wright
_biz_reviews.text: Came here for the All You CAN EAT crawfish and royal red shrimp. It's only $19.99 and last from 2-7pm Saturdays and Sundays only! Also… comes with conecuh sausage, corn and potatoes. Best deal I've came across on the island!

_biz_reviews.author: Kimberlee Weber
_biz_reviews.text: My family members love the all you can eat shrimp boil that is on Saturday and Sundays. They have the best cheeseburgers there also. We come every time we visit.

_biz_reviews.author: Brittany Bulfer
_biz_reviews.text: 1st time here got wings!! Good experience!! Loved it Great music happy hour on Wednesdays 1.00 off drinks!!

_biz_reviews.author: Bill Wright
_biz_reviews.text: This is the spot for drinks, vapes, pool, and the best darn burger you want to eat, only $15 with delicious crispy fries!

google_raw_data.name: Tiki & Raw Bar

reviews.text: So I hate to leave really negative reviews but the staff needs to do better also. We stood at the hostess table for 10min before we were told to seat ourselves. Now the live music could have been the issue. We sat outside for the view. We have eaten here before so no biggie. We ordered everything at once cause we had a long wait before our server saw us. We had to flag down another server to replace the sour tea we were given. The food was great, just someone had a bad night. For the sever who we had to flag down, if you had to help us out, why not just keep an eye on us. I don’t care if it’s not your table, we’re paying money, we shouldn’t be penalized cause an employee is having a bad night.

Food and drinks were really good.  Service was good but slow...there seemed to be 1 dedicated person to the outside venue and it was full because of the live music.  The server was doing his best and our orders were always correct...it was busy and live music scheduled....made service slow.  I do recommend visiting and we will be back.

So sad this place is so far removed from other areas, but that may be a contributing factor to it's amazing atmosphere. The service was exemplary. The good was delicious and filling and the bartender actually made my old fashioned as directed AND it was delicious! Lol! Hanging off the Pier this is an open air island paradise that begs for you to enjoy the beautiful weather while you drink and/or eat.
Love this place! The servers Raquel and Abigail were amazing. Great energy and work ethic!! Food and atmosphere are great!
We l8ve this place. Definitely a local favorite

tripadvisor_description: Tiki's Grill & Bar is an ocean-view restaurant overlooking Waikiki Beach. We serve fresh, locally sourced island cuisine with a Pacific Rim flair - from fresh fish & seafood to premium steaks, meats & farm-fresh produce. Our big menu offers something for everyone, with pupus, salads & hearty entrées. Guests enjoy both outdoor & indoor seating for lunch, happy hour, or a romantic sunset dinner. Tropical cocktails in tiki mugs, souvenir glassware & real coconut cups add fun. Choose from local beers, a wine list, and tiki classics like the Lava Flow or the legendary 1944 Mai Tai (debated if Don the Beachcomber or Trader Vic created it). Our craft cocktail bar, The Lava Lounge, offers an elevated experience. From Waikiki's best happy hour to live music with local bands & hula, check our entertainment calendar. Tiki's delivers unforgettable aloha - perfect for families, couples & groups. Locally owned by 3 UH grads with ohana roots in Waikiki for 5+ generations.
